business_case.narrative: Northstar handles about ten million assisted contacts a year, mostly by phone. Five levers apply in order, so nothing is counted twice. The largest are AI resolution of routine requests and faster handling. All rates are planning assumptions. Lead with the low scenario and validate with Northstar's data.

outreach.positioning: We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. Each channel works well alone. The gaps appear when customers move between them.

steps.subject: Northstar's service journey, seen from outside
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it.

In-app chat stands out. Replies arrive in under two minutes and agents finish card tasks in the chat.

One thing we noticed on the phone. Your help page asks app callers for card number and ID again.

Could I share the two-page view in a 20-minute call next week?

{{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, we looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. In-app chat is a real strength. The step from app to hotline looks like the place to start. Happy to send the two-page view. {{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{sdr_name}} from Sprinklr. I will be brief. We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. Your published standards show a peak hotline wait of 5 minutes 40 seconds. Your help page also asks app callers to identify themselves again. Is carrying context from app to phone on your list for next year? If so, I can walk you through what we saw.

steps.subject: The model behind the view
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A short follow-up on our outside-in view of Northstar's service journey.

We also built an illustrative model of what the gaps may cost. It uses public volumes and benchmarks, so it needs your data to be right.

I would rather walk you through the assumptions than send a number.

Is 20 minutes worth it? If not, tell me and I will close the file.

{{sdr_name}}

steps.subject: When a customer asks Navi for a person
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. Navi was our first stop.

It is always on, needs no login and says clearly that it is a virtual assistant. Your annual report says it handles 58% of web chats alone.

One step stood out. Your help article says Navi cannot connect a customer to a person. The customer gets the hotline number or a callback form.

Could I show you the full view in 20 minutes?

{{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, we looked at Northstar's service channels the way a customer sees them. Navi is strong on answers. The step from Navi to a person is where the journey restarts. I can send our two-page view. {{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, {{sdr_name}} from Sprinklr. One minute, then you decide. We looked at Northstar's service channels the way a customer sees them. Navi answers well. Your help article says it cannot connect a customer to a person. I know your team builds Navi in-house. We are not asking you to replace it. Would it help to see how others pass context from assistant to agent?

steps.subject: Navi Plus and the hand-over
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

One more thought on our outside-in view.

Navi Plus is in pilot with 300,000 customers. The harder test comes when it cannot finish a request.

We mapped where each channel hands over today, and where the customer starts again.

Is it worth 20 minutes to compare notes? I can send the view first.

{{sdr_name}}

steps.subject: Seven stages of Northstar's service journey
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it, across seven stages.

The app is a clear strength. It holds a 4.6 rating from 212,000 ratings.

The last stage is where we saw room. In a sample of 60 public posts, the median first reply took over four hours. Most replies moved the customer to a private message or the hotline.

Could I share the two-page view in a short call?

{{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, we looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. Each channel works well alone. The friction sits between them, where customers explain things twice. I can send the two-page view. {{sdr_name}}

Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{sdr_name}} from Sprinklr. I will keep it short. We looked at Northstar's service journey the way a customer sees it. We found five things that work well. We also found ten places where the customer slows down or starts again. Would you like the two-page view before we talk? I can send it today.

steps.subject: A first view to test with you
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Last note from me on this.

Our view of Northstar's journey is built only from public sources. Some of it will be wrong.

That is why I would like to test it with you. Twenty minutes is enough to see where we are right.

If the timing is off, tell me and I will come back next quarter.

{{sdr_name}}

discovery_questions.question: Who owns a service question that arrives on a social page?
discovery_questions.why_ask: Tests whether social care sits with service or marketing.

discovery_questions.question: How will you measure complaint-handling times for the 2027 rule?
discovery_questions.why_ask: Links follow-up gaps to a dated requirement.

discovery_questions.question: What must be true before Navi Plus moves beyond the pilot?
discovery_questions.why_ask: Surfaces their AI release criteria and risk owners.

discovery_questions.question: What would you most like WhatsApp to do that it cannot do today?
discovery_questions.why_ask: Tests demand for verified, task-completing messaging.

objections.response: Keep it. Navi already handles 58% of web chats. We focus on the hand-over to people and on testing before release.

objections.objection: We already use Helix CRM for service.
objections.response: It stays the system of record. We connect to it and add the channels and context around the agent.

objections.objection: Our telephony contract has years to run.
objections.response: Then start with digital channels and context. Voice can follow when the contract allows.

objections.objection: We are in a cost programme. No new spend.
objections.response: That is why we modelled cost levers first. Let us test the low scenario with your data.

objections.objection: Sprinklr is a social media tool.
objections.response: Social care is one part. Forrester named Sprinklr a Strong Performer for contact-centre platforms in Q2 2025.

do_not_say: Do not claim a Gartner Magic Quadrant position for contact centre as a service. Sprinklr is not in the 2025 or 2026 editions.
Do not say Sprinklr cuts contact-centre costs by 30%. That claim is unverified.
Do not name a reference bank in APJI for Sprinklr Service. None is published with results.
Do not present the Forrester 210% ROI study as new. Its date is unclear.
Do not name VoxCore CX, Helix CRM, Pingline Messaging or Chorus Social to the prospect.
Do not quote the 1% quality sampling estimate as fact. It comes from one job advert.
Do not open with the September outage or the complaints rule. Let them raise it.
Do not mention a 2027 tender or contract renewal. Both are unverified.
Do not say Navi is weak. It handles 58% of web chats alone.
Do not quote a value number in outreach. Offer to walk through the model.
Never say we tested, audited or mystery-shopped their contact centre.
Never share live-test screenshots or transcripts. Never name their staff.

prospect_view.title: Northstar Pacific Bank: your service journey, seen from outside
prospect_view.subtitle: Fictional sample. An outside-in first view, built only from public sources.
prospect_view.framing: We looked at your public service channels the way a customer sees them. This is a first view to test with you. Scores are outside-in estimates, not facts about your operation.

strengths.text: In-app chat replies in under two minutes, and agents complete card tasks in the chat.
Navi is always on, needs no login and handled 58% of web chats alone.
You tell customers when AI answers, and review AI answers before release.

observations.title: From assistant to person
observations.text: Asking Navi for a person returns the hotline number and a callback form. The chat does not continue with an agent.

observations.title: Telling the story twice
observations.text: The 'Calling us' page asks callers to have card number and ID ready. This includes calls made from the app.

observations.title: Knowing it is done
observations.text: Secure message replies come from a no-reply address. Card dispute outcomes arrive by letter, with no online tracker mentioned.

observations.title: Replies in public
observations.text: In a sample of 60 public posts, the median first reply took 4 hours 10 minutes. 44 replies moved the customer to another channel.

opportunities.title: One conversation, from assistant to agent
opportunities.what_good_looks_like: The assistant passes the full conversation to a live agent. The customer never starts again.

opportunities.title: Known on every channel
opportunities.what_good_looks_like: A customer verified in the app is recognised on the phone and in messaging. Agents see one history.

opportunities.title: Answers in public, updates without asking
opportunities.what_good_looks_like: Public questions get a first reply within the hour. Customers receive progress updates without having to ask.

prospect_view.cta: Spend 30 minutes with us to test this view against your own data.

evidence.claim: Northstar Pacific Bank serves 6.1 million retail customers in three markets.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Northstar Pacific Bank Annual Report FY2025
evidence.quote: We serve 6.1 million customers across Port Meridian, Selanta and the Orivu Islands.

evidence.claim: The 'Simply Service 2028' plan targets 80% of service contacts on digital channels and a 45% cost-to-income ratio.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Investor Day 2026: Simply Service 2028
evidence.quote: By 2028, four in five service contacts will start and finish on a digital channel.

evidence.claim: A July 2026 job advert seeks a telephony engineer for an on-premise VoxCore CX platform.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Job advert: Telephony Engineer, Contact Centre Platforms
evidence.quote: Maintain and upgrade our on-premise VoxCore CX contact centre platform.

evidence.claim: A 2024 tender notice named VoxCore CX as contact-centre telephony supplier on a five-year term.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Tender award notice: contact centre telephony

evidence.claim: Helix CRM lists Northstar as a customer for case management and in-app chat.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Helix CRM customer page: Northstar Pacific Bank
evidence.quote: Northstar runs service cases and in-app chat on Helix Service Desk.

evidence.claim: A forum post says the Helix CRM contract is due for renewal in mid-2027.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - CX technology forum thread

evidence.claim: Social care appears to run on Chorus Social, a marketing tool, with weekly spreadsheet reports.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Job advert: Social Community Executive
evidence.method: Job advert asks for Chorus Social skills and a weekly export of mentions to spreadsheets. One advert, no second source.

evidence.claim: The contact page lists 11 ways to get help, from a 24/7 hotline to social pages.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Contact us
evidence.quote: Call us any time, day or night, in three languages.

evidence.claim: More than 1,000 service colleagues answered over 4 million hotline calls in FY2025.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Sustainability Report FY2025
evidence.quote: Our 1,000-plus service colleagues answered over 4 million calls.

evidence.claim: Published standards show a 5 min 40 s peak hotline wait and 71% first-call resolution. In-app chat replies in under two minutes.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Our service standards, Q3 2026
evidence.quote: Average peak wait 5 min 40 s. First-call resolution 71%. Median first chat reply 1 min 50 s.

evidence.claim: In-app chat needs a login and has live agents from 8am to 10pm. Agents can freeze cards and change limits.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Help article: Chat with us in the app
evidence.quote: Because you are logged in, our team can see your accounts. Chat history is kept for 90 days.

evidence.claim: Secure messages offer nine fixed topics, a three-working-day reply target and replies from a no-reply address.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Help article: Send us a secure message
evidence.quote: We aim to reply within three working days. To follow up, please send a new message.

evidence.claim: WhatsApp service launched in November 2025 in two markets and handled 1.5 million conversations in its first year.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Press release: One year of Northstar on WhatsApp
evidence.quote: Customers in Port Meridian and Selanta started 1.5 million conversations, delivered with our partner Pingline Messaging.

evidence.claim: The WhatsApp service opens with a six-option menu and sends account questions to the app or the hotline.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Help article: Message us on WhatsApp
evidence.quote: Type AGENT any time. Agents reply 8am to 8pm, usually within 10 minutes. For account questions, log in to the app or call us.

evidence.claim: The branch locator lists 84 branches with live queue times and an appointment form.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Branch locator

evidence.claim: In-app chat handles about 2.4 million conversations a year.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Account Radar estimate: in-app chat volume
evidence.method: 6.1M customers x 55% active app users (assumption) x 0.7 chats per user a year (assumption) = 2.35M. Range plus or minus 25%.

evidence.claim: Secure messages and web forms total about 1.3 million a year.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Account Radar estimate: secure message volume
evidence.method: 6.1M customers x 0.21 written requests per customer a year (assumption) = 1.28M. Range plus or minus 30%.

evidence.claim: The web assistant Navi handles about 3.0 million sessions a year.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Account Radar estimate: web assistant sessions
evidence.method: About 25M help-page visits a year (traffic estimate) x 12% assistant open rate (assumption) = 3.0M. Range plus or minus 25%.

evidence.claim: The mobile app holds a 4.6 out of 5 rating from 212,000 ratings.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - App store listing: Northstar Mobile

evidence.claim: Of 120 recent public reviews, 41 mention hotline hold time. 14 mention slow secure message replies.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Review site sample, 120 reviews read
evidence.quote: Forty minutes on hold to unblock a card.

evidence.claim: In 60 public social posts from October 2026, the median first reply took 4 h 10 min. 44 replies redirected the customer.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Public social reply sample, 60 posts timed
evidence.quote: Hi, please send us a private message or call our hotline.

evidence.claim: The 'Meet Navi' page shows a labelled virtual assistant on every help page, 24/7, with no login.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Help article: Meet Navi, our virtual assistant
evidence.quote: I'm Navi, Northstar's virtual assistant. Instant answers on every help page, any time. No login needed.

evidence.claim: A help article says Navi cannot connect customers to a person. For card disputes it gives a guide and the hotline number.

evidence.quote: Navi can't connect you to a colleague yet. Please call our hotline or request a callback. For card disputes, Navi shares our dispute guide and hotline number.

evidence.claim: The 'Calling us' page shows a five-option keypad menu. It asks all callers, including app callers, for card number and ID.

evidence.quote: Have your card number and ID ready, even if you call from the app. Press 0 at any time to speak to us.

evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Help article: Disputing a card payment
evidence.quote: We will write to you with the outcome within 30 days.

evidence.claim: The annual report says the in-house assistant Navi handled 58% of web chats without a human in FY2025.
evidence.source_title: FICTIONAL - Northstar Pacific Bank Annual Report FY2025, digital section
evidence.quote: Navi, built by our own engineers, resolved 58% of web chats without a colleague.

evidence.method: Advert asks analysts to score five calls per agent a month. Five calls / about 480 calls per agent a month = about 1%.
